tools.name: get_resume
tools.description: Ruben Marcus' full resume: summary, work experience, skills, proof points, open source projects, education, links, and a PDF CV URL.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Fixed-scope services Ruben sells, with one-line pitches.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Current availability for full-time roles and freelance contracts.

tools.name: book_intro
tools.description: Book a project intro with Ruben. Relays the brief to his email.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_resume · Public sink: book_intro.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_resume · Public sink: book_intro

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
